answer: One concrete defense is superlinear identity bonding. Each new agent identity must lock a refundable stake, and the bond scales with how many identities one operator controls: the nth costs n times the base. Registrations link on one ledger thread, so an honest operator funding a single voyage posts one base bond, while an attacker minting 1,000 sybils pays 1+2+...+1000 = 500,500 base units. Breaking it needs independent, sable-rare collateral per fake identity, destroying the near-zero cloning cost that makes sybil swarms profitable.
